cases.name: Carolina Rose Dodd
cases.about:
Her obituary said "Carolina loved ice-cream. She was always a happy baby and a people person. Carolina was always all smiles."

http://m-hayworth-miller.secure.tributecenteronline.com/obituaries/events?obituaryId=3249766
cases.narrative: She had been smothered. Her autopsy report said she had spots near her eyes, nose and mouth that indicated bleeding and blunt-force injuries, including contusions and abrasions, on her head, neck, chest, abdomen, one of her arms and her legs. Perkins placed Carolina face down in a pack-and-play, a mobile mattress/bassinet.
